BrochureContent.Content:
No. 34 Pineridge is a spacious bungalow presented in good condition throughout, offering excellent potential for modernisation and refurbishment to create an outstanding family home in a highly desirable location. Situated within this mature and sought-after residential neighbourhood, the property enjoys convenient access to a wide range of local amenities, while a regular bus service is available just a short walk away. The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a generously proportioned living room,with two double bedrooms and a single bedroom located off the main hallway. To the rear of the property is the principal bedroom with en-suite bathroom, together with a fully fitted kitchen, utility room, and adjoining storage room. Outside, the property benefits from off-street parking and a front driveway. The rear garden enjoys excellent privacy and is not overlooked, providing a peaceful outdoor space. Conveniently located approximately 1km from Wexford Town Centre, The Quays, and Redmond Square, all essential amenities including shops, schools (3rd level), churches, and supermarkets are within easy reach. The N11 and M11 road networks are also readily accessible, placing Dublin City and Dublin Airport approximately two hours away, while Rosslare Europort is just 21 km from the property. A selection of Wexford’s finest beaches are only a short drive away, including Curracloe’s Blue Flag Beach, recently voted Ireland’s Best Beach, along with Rosslare Strand and Ballinesker Beach. The National Heritage Park, along with the scenic walking trails at Forth Mountain and Carrigfoyle, are also close by, offering a mix of history, nature, and panoramic views. Properties in this established and highly regarded neighbourhood rarely come to the market, making an excellent opportunity for purchasers seeking a home with space, potential, and an exceptional location.
